name: claude-ship
description: Distributes the ship workflow that turns a request into an Issue and implements it until green, together with its dependent skills (create-issue / issue-loop / code-review).

plugins.name: ship-session
plugins.description: A workflow that turns a request into a GitHub Issue and implements it in the same session until every acceptance criterion is met, verification is green, and the review has zero findings. It decides the goal (Issue / implementation / PR / merge) once before starting and stops there.

plugins.name: ship-session-jev
plugins.description: An add-on to ship-session that lets Jev (TypeSafe AI's System One model) decide the goal from the request and skip the Phase 0 question when its confidence is high. Optional and fail-open: without TYPESAFE_API_KEY, or when the API fails, it behaves exactly like ship-session. Requires ship-session.

plugins.name: graph-workflow
plugins.description: Breaks a task into a graph of nodes and edges and runs it deterministically in parallel with the Workflow tool. It shows the graph design for approval first and resumes midway on failure.
